subject: Re: SpICE status: eval battery reproduced, realistic speech is the hard part
body:
Team,

Decisions before the retrain window:

1. Confidence bands are in: the API ships predicted class + adjacent-class confidence, per Linnea's recommendation. The within-one-class >95% figure becomes our headline clinical metric, and we say plainly that exact-class on unprompted speech is weaker.
2. Retrain is a GO: our cirrus-tpu week (128 accelerators, week of June 1) starts Monday, and the retraining configs are frozen tonight. Linnea's freeze discipline made this easy - thank you.
3. Privacy: Kofi's review cleared May 20 with one condition, on-device redaction of any transcribable content in partner uploads. Paloma owns the implementation; it gates the launch review, not the retrain.

If the retrained model holds the eval battery, we walk into the June 12 launch-review checkpoint with a complete story.

Goran
